units.zh: 馬楊路盧
units.en: Ma, Yang, Lu, and Lu
units.literal: Ma, Yang, Lu, and Lu

units.zh: 馬植，字存之，鳳州刺史勛子也。
units.en: Ma Zhi, whose courtesy name was Cunzhi, was the son of Ma Xun, prefect of Fengzhou.
units.literal: Ma Zhi, courtesy name Cunzhi, was the son of Fengzhou Prefect Ma Xun.

units.zh: 第進士，又擢制策科，補校書郎。
units.en: He passed the jinshi examination, was also chosen in the decree-examination category, and was appointed a collator.
units.literal: He passed the jinshi examination, was also selected in the decree-examination category, and was appointed collator.

units.zh: 由壽州團練副使三遷饒州刺史。
units.en: Starting as deputy commissioner of the Shouzhou training circuit, he was promoted three times until he became prefect of Raozhou.
units.literal: From deputy commissioner of the Shouzhou training circuit he was transferred three times until he became prefect of Raozhou.

units.zh: 開成初，為安南都護。
units.en: At the start of the Kaicheng era he was made Protector-General of Annan.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Kaicheng era he served as Protector-General of Annan.

units.zh: 精吏事，以文雅絢飾其政，清凈不煩，洞夷便安。
units.en: Skilled in administration, he lent literary polish to his governance; his rule was clean and light-handed, and the frontier peoples lived in peace and comfort.
units.literal: He was skilled in administrative affairs and adorned his governance with literary elegance; his rule was pure and unburdensome, and the distant tribes found security and ease.

units.zh: 羈縻諸首領皆來納款，遣子弟詣府，請賦租約束。
units.en: The chieftains of the frontier dependencies all came to pledge allegiance, sending sons and younger brothers to the prefectural seat to ask for tax and levy regulations.
units.literal: All the frontier chieftains came to submit allegiance, sending sons and younger brothers to the prefectural seat to request tax and levy regulations.

units.zh: 植奏以武陸縣為陸州，即柬首領為刺史。
units.en: Zhi memorialized to elevate Wulu County to Luzhou and appoint the Jian chieftain as its prefect.
units.literal: Zhi memorialized to establish Wulu County as Luzhou and appoint the Jian chieftain as prefect.

units.zh: 既而州部廢池珠復生。
units.en: Before long pearls appeared again in the prefecture's abandoned pearl pools.
units.literal: Soon thereafter pearls reappeared in the abandoned pearl pools of the prefecture.

units.zh: 以政最，檢校左散騎常侍，徙黔中觀察使。
units.en: Rated highest for his governance, he was made acting Left Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and transferred to surveillance commissioner of Qianzhong.
units.literal: For outstanding governance he was made acting Left Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and transferred to be surveillance commissioner of Qianzhong.

units.zh: 會昌中，召拜光祿卿，遷大理。
units.en: In the Huichang period he was recalled and appointed Director of the Imperial Table, then moved to the Court of Judicial Review.
units.literal: During the Huichang era he was summoned and appointed Director of the Imperial Table, then transferred to the Court of Judicial Review.

units.zh: 植自以譽望在當時諸公右，久補外，還朝不得要官，為宰相李德裕所抑，內怨望。
units.en: Zhi believed his renown outranked the other leading men of the day; after long provincial service, he returned to court without receiving a key post and was held down by Chief Minister Li Deyu, nursing resentment inwardly.
units.literal: Zhi considered his reputation and standing to rank above the other leading officials of the time; after long service in provincial posts, on returning to court he did not receive an important office and was suppressed by Chief Minister Li Deyu, harboring resentment within.

units.zh: 宣宗嗣位，白敏中當國，凡德裕所不善，悉不次用之，故植以刑部侍郎領諸道鹽鐵轉運使，遷戶部，俄同中書門下平章事，進中書侍郎。
units.en: After Emperor Xuanzong took the throne, Bai Minzhong directed the state; everyone Li Deyu had disliked was promoted out of turn, so Zhi served as Vice Minister of Justice while heading the salt-and-iron transport commissioners of all circuits, moved to the Ministry of Revenue, and soon became Grand Councillor, rising to Vice Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong succeeded to the throne, Bai Minzhong held state power; everyone Li Deyu had disliked was promoted out of turn, and thus Zhi served as Vice Minister of Justice while overseeing the salt and iron transport commissioners of all circuits, was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue, and soon became Grand Councillor of the Secretariat and Chancery, advanced to Vice Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 初，左軍中尉馬元贄最為帝寵信，賜通天犀帶。
units.en: Earlier, Left Army Commandant Ma Yuanzan was the emperor's most favored and trusted man and was given a belt of penetrating-heaven rhinoceros horn.
units.literal: Earlier, the Left Army Commandant Ma Yuanzan was the one most favored and trusted by the emperor, and was granted a belt of penetrating-heaven rhinoceros horn.

units.zh: 而植素與元贄善，至通昭穆，元贄以賜帶遺之。
units.en: Zhi had long been close to Yuanzan, even using generational kinship terms with him; Yuanzan gave him the imperial belt as a gift.
units.literal: Zhi had long been on good terms with Yuanzan, even addressing each other by generational kinship terms; Yuanzan gave him the granted belt as a gift.

units.zh: 它日對便殿，帝識其帶，以詰植，植震恐，具言狀，於是罷為天平軍節度使。
units.en: On another day in the informal audience hall the emperor recognized his belt and questioned Zhi; terrified, Zhi told the whole story, and was removed to serve as military governor of Tianping.
units.literal: Another day, facing the emperor in the informal palace hall, the emperor recognized his belt and questioned Zhi; Zhi was terrified and explained the whole matter, and was therefore dismissed to serve as military governor of the Tianping army.

units.zh: 既行，詔捕親吏下御史獄，盡得交私狀，貶常州刺史，以太子賓客分司東都。
units.en: Once he had left, an edict had his close clerks seized and sent to the censorate prison; every private dealing was exposed, and he was demoted to prefect of Changzhou and made Palace Companion with duties at the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: After he departed, an edict ordered his close clerks arrested and sent to the censorate prison; all private dealings were fully uncovered, and he was demoted to prefect of Changzhou and appointed Palace Companion with duties at the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 起為忠武、宣武節度使，卒。
units.en: He was recalled to serve as military governor of Zhongwu and Xuanwu, and died.
units.literal: He was recalled to serve as military governor of Zhongwu and Xuanwu, then died.

units.zh: 初，植兼集賢殿大學士，校理楊收道與三院御史遇，不肯避，朝長馮緘錄其騶仆辱之。
units.en: Earlier, while Zhi also held the post of Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, collator Yang Shou met censors of the three bureaus on the road and refused to yield; morning chief Feng Jian took down his outriders and servants and humiliated him.
units.literal: Earlier, while Zhi also served as Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, collator Yang Shou encountered censors of the three bureaus on the road and would not yield; the morning chief Feng Jian recorded his outriders and servants and humiliated him.

units.zh: 植怒，奏言：「開元中，麗正殿賜酒，大學士張說以下十八人不知先舉者，說以學士德行相先，遂同舉酒。
units.en: Zhi, furious, memorialized: "In Kaiyuan, when wine was granted at the Lize Hall, the eighteen grand academicians from Zhang Yue on down did not know who should drink first; Yue said that among academicians precedence follows virtue, and they all raised their cups together.
units.literal: Zhi was angry and memorialized: "In the Kaiyuan era, when wine was granted at the Lize Hall, the eighteen grand academicians from Zhang Yue downward did not know who should raise the cup first; Yue said that among academicians precedence follows moral conduct, and so they all raised their cups together.

units.zh: 今緘辱收，與大學士等。
units.en: Now Jian has humiliated Shou as though he were on a par with a grand academician.
units.literal: Now Jian has humiliated Shou as if he were the equal of a grand academician.

units.zh: 請斥之。」
units.en: I ask that he be removed."
units.literal: I request that he be dismissed."

units.zh: 中丞令狐援故事論救，宣宗釋不問。
units.en: Vice Censor-in-Chief Linghu Yuan cited precedent in pleading for leniency, and Emperor Xuanzong let the matter drop.
units.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief Linghu Yuan cited precedent in arguing for leniency, and Emperor Xuanzong released the matter without inquiry.

units.zh: 因著令「三館學士不避行臺」，自植始。
units.en: A regulation was then issued that "academicians of the three halls need not yield to the executive terrace," beginning with Zhi.
units.literal: Thereupon a regulation was issued that "academicians of the three halls need not yield to the executive terrace," beginning with Zhi.

units.zh: 臺制：「三院還臺，以一人為朝長雲。」
units.en: Censorate regulation: "When the three bureaus return to the terrace, one person serves as morning chief."
units.literal: Censorate regulation: "When the three bureaus return to the terrace, one person serves as morning chief."

units.zh: 楊收，字藏之，自言隋越國公素之裔，世居馮翊。
units.en: Yang Shou, courtesy name Cangzhi, claimed descent from Yang Su, Duke of Yue of Sui, and said his family had long lived in Fengyi.
units.literal: Yang Shou, courtesy name Cangzhi, claimed to be a descendant of Sui Duke of Yue Yang Su and that his family had long lived in Fengyi.

units.zh: 父遺直，德宗時，以上書闕下，仕為濠州錄事參軍，客死姑蘇。
units.en: His father Yizhi, in Dezong's time, entered office by submitting a memorial at court and served as recording secretary of Haozhou, dying away from home in Gusu.
units.literal: His father Yizhi, during the Dezong era, by submitting a memorial at the palace gates entered service as recording secretary of Haozhou and died as a guest in Gusu.

units.zh: 收七歲而孤，處喪若成人。
units.en: Shou lost his father at seven and observed mourning like a grown man.
units.literal: Shou was orphaned at seven and observed mourning as if he were an adult.

units.zh: 母長孫親授經，十三通大義。
units.en: His mother, a Zhangsun, taught him the classics herself; by thirteen he had mastered their broad meaning.
units.literal: His mother, of the Zhangsun clan, personally taught him the classics; at thirteen he had mastered their broad meaning.

units.zh: 善屬文，所賦輒就，吳人號神童。
units.en: Skilled at writing, he finished every fu he undertook on the spot, and the people of Wu called him a prodigy.
units.literal: He was skilled at composition; whatever fu he undertook was completed at once, and the people of Wu called him a divine child.

units.zh: 裏人多造門觀賦詩，至壓敗其藩。
units.en: Neighbors crowded his gate to watch him compose, until they broke down his fence.
units.literal: Many neighbors came to his gate to watch him compose poetry, until they crushed his fence.

units.zh: 收嘲之曰：「爾非羸角者，奚用觸吾藩？」
units.en: Shou mocked them: "You are not hornless calves—why butt against my fence?"
units.literal: Shou mocked them, saying: "You are not hornless calves—why do you butt against my fence?"

units.zh: 切當率類此。
units.en: His pointed remarks were generally of this kind.
units.literal: His pointed remarks were generally of this sort.

units.zh: 及壯，長六尺二寸，廣顙深頤，疏眉目，寡言笑，博學強記，至它藝無不通解。
units.en: Grown, he stood six feet two inches, with a broad forehead and deep jaw, sparse brows and eyes, and little speech or laughter; widely learned with a formidable memory, there was scarcely any other art he could not master.
units.literal: When grown he stood six feet two inches, with a broad forehead and deep jaw, sparse brows and eyes, few words and little laughter; he was broadly learned with a powerful memory, and there was no other art he could not master.

units.zh: 貧甚，以母奉浮屠法，自幼不食肉。
units.en: Very poor, and because his mother followed Buddhism, he had eaten no meat since childhood.
units.literal: He was very poor; because his mother followed the Buddhist law, from childhood he ate no meat.

units.zh: 約曰：「爾得進士第，乃可食。」
units.en: She bound him: "Only when you pass the jinshi examination may you eat meat."
units.literal: She made a pact: "Only when you attain the jinshi degree may you eat it."

units.zh: 涔陽耕得古鐘，高尺餘，收扣之，曰：「此姑洗角也。」
units.en: Plowing at Cenyang he turned up an ancient bell more than a foot high; Shou struck it and said, "This is the jue pitch of Guxian."
units.literal: While plowing at Cenyang he unearthed an ancient bell more than a foot high; Shou struck it and said: "This is the jue of Guxian."

units.zh: 既劀拭，有刻在兩欒，果然。
units.en: Once scraped and cleaned, an inscription on both raised bands proved him right.
units.literal: After it was scraped and wiped clean, there was an inscription on both raised bands, and it was indeed so.

units.zh: 嘗言：「琴通黃鐘、姑洗、無射三均，側出諸調，由羅蔦附灌木然。」
units.en: He once said, "The qin spans the three keys of Huangzhong, Guxian, and Wuyi; subsidiary modes branch off like bindweed clinging to shrubs."
units.literal: He once said: "The qin connects the three keys of Huangzhong, Guxian, and Wuyi; the subsidiary modes branch out like convolvulus clinging to shrubs."

units.zh: 時有安涚者，世稱善琴，且知音。
units.en: At the time there was An Shu, renowned for skill on the qin and for understanding music.
units.literal: At the time there was An Shu, whom the age called skilled at the qin and also knowledgeable in music.

units.zh: 收問：「五弦外，其二雲何？」
units.en: Shou asked, "Beyond the five strings, what are the other two?"
units.literal: Shou asked: "Beyond the five strings, what are the other two?"

units.zh: 涚曰：「世謂周文、武二王所加者。」
units.en: Shu said, "People say Kings Wen and Wu of Zhou added them."
units.literal: Shu said: "The age says they were added by Kings Wen and Wu of Zhou."

units.zh: 收曰：「能為《文王操》乎？」
units.en: Shou said, "Can you play the Ballad of King Wen?"
units.literal: Shou said: "Can you perform the 'Ballad of King Wen'?"

units.zh: 涚即以黃鐘為宮而奏之，以少商應大弦，收曰：「止！
units.en: Shu at once took Huangzhong as tonic and played, answering the great string with lesser shang; Shou said, "Stop!
units.literal: Shu immediately took Huangzhong as the tonic and played it, answering the great string with the lesser shang; Shou said: "Stop!

units.zh: 如子之言，少商，武弦也。
units.en: As you say, lesser shang is King Wu's string.
units.literal: As you say, the lesser shang is the string of King Wu.

units.zh: 且文世安得武聲乎？」
units.en: Besides, how could King Wu's sound appear in King Wen's age?"
units.literal: Moreover, how could there be the sound of Wu in the age of Wen?"

units.zh: 涚大驚，因問樂意，收曰：「樂亡久矣。
units.en: Shu was astonished and asked about musical meaning; Shou said, "Music has been lost for a long time.
units.literal: Shu was greatly startled and then asked about musical meaning; Shou said: "Music has long been lost.

units.zh: 上古祀天地宗廟，皆不用商。
units.en: In high antiquity, sacrifices to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples all avoided the shang mode.
units.literal: In high antiquity, sacrifices to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples all avoided shang.

units.zh: 周人歌大呂、舞《雲門》以俟天神，歌太蔟、舞《鹹池》以俟地祇。
units.en: The Zhou sang Dalü and danced the Cloud Gate to await the heavenly spirit, and sang Taicu and danced the Brine Pool to await the earthly spirit.
units.literal: The Zhou people sang Dalü and danced the "Cloud Gate" to await the spirit of Heaven, and sang Taicu and danced the "Brine Pool" to await the spirit of Earth.

units.zh: 大呂、黃鐘之合，陽聲之首。
units.en: The pairing of Dalü and Huangzhong is the head of the yang pitches.
units.literal: The union of Dalü and Huangzhong is the head of the yang pitches.

units.zh: 而《雲門》，黃帝樂也；
units.en: Yet the Cloud Gate is the Yellow Emperor's music;
units.literal: Yet the "Cloud Gate" is the music of the Yellow Emperor;

units.zh: 《鹹池》，堯樂也。
units.en: the Brine Pool is Yao's music.
units.literal: the "Brine Pool" is the music of Yao.

units.zh: 不敢用黃鐘，而以太蔟次之。
units.en: They dared not use Huangzhong and therefore set Taicu next instead.
units.literal: They dared not use Huangzhong and therefore placed Taicu next.

units.zh: 然則祭天者，圜鐘為宮，黃鐘為角，太蔟為徵，姑洗為羽；
units.en: Thus for sacrifices to Heaven, Yuanzhong was tonic, Huangzhong jue, Taicu zhi, and Guxian yu;
units.literal: Thus for sacrifices to Heaven, Yuanzhong served as tonic, Huangzhong as jue, Taicu as zhi, and Guxian as yu;

units.zh: 祭地者，函鐘為宮，太蔟為角，姑洗為徵，南呂為羽。
units.en: for sacrifices to Earth, Hanzhong was tonic, Taicu jue, Guxian zhi, and Nanlü yu.
units.literal: for sacrifices to Earth, Hanzhong served as tonic, Taicu as jue, Guxian as zhi, and Nanlü as yu.

units.zh: 訖不用商及二少。
units.en: In the end shang and the two lesser pitches were never used.
units.literal: In the end shang and the two lesser pitches were not used.

units.zh: 蓋商聲剛而二少聲下，所以取其正、裁其繁也。
units.en: For shang is forceful and the two lesser pitches are low—this was to keep what is correct and cut away excess.
units.literal: For shang is a forceful pitch and the two lesser pitches are low—this was to take what is correct and trim what is excessive.

units.zh: 漢祭天則用商，而宗廟不用，謂鬼神畏商之剛。
units.en: The Han used shang for sacrifices to Heaven but not in the ancestral temple, saying spirits fear shang's force.
units.literal: The Han used shang in sacrifices to Heaven but not in the ancestral temple, saying that spirits fear the force of shang.

units.zh: 西京諸儒惑圜鐘、函鐘之說，故其自受命，郊祀、宗廟樂，唯用黃鐘一均。
units.en: Western Capital scholars were misled by doctrines of Yuanzhong and Hanzhong, so from receiving the Mandate onward suburban and ancestral temple music used only the Huangzhong key.
units.literal: The scholars of the Western Capital were confused by the doctrines of Yuanzhong and Hanzhong, and so from the time they received the Mandate, suburban sacrifices and ancestral temple music used only the single key of Huangzhong.

units.zh: 章帝時，太常丞鮑業始旋十二宮。
units.en: Under Emperor Zhang, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Bao Ye first rotated the twelve keys.
units.literal: In the time of Emperor Zhang, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Bao Ye first rotated the twelve keys.

units.zh: 夫旋宮以七聲為均，均，言韻也，古無韻字，猶言一韻聲也。
units.en: Rotating keys treats the seven pitches as a key; jun means rhyme—in antiquity there was no separate character for rhyme, so it is like speaking of one rhyming sound.
units.literal: Rotating keys takes the seven pitches as a key; jun means rhyme—in antiquity there was no character for rhyme, so it is as if one spoke of a single rhyming sound.

units.zh: 始以某律為宮，某律為商，某律為角，某律為徵，某律為羽，某律少宮，某律少徵，亦曰『變』，曰『比』。
units.en: First one pitch serves as tonic, another as shang, jue, zhi, yu, lesser tonic, and lesser zhi—also called change and comparison.
units.literal: First one pitch is taken as tonic, another as shang, another as jue, another as zhi, another as yu, another as lesser tonic, another as lesser zhi—also called "change" and "comparison."

units.zh: 一均成則五聲為之節族，此旋宮也。」
units.en: When one key is complete, the five pitches form its scale—this is key rotation."
units.literal: When one key is complete, the five pitches form its scale degrees—this is rotating keys."

units.zh: 乃取律次之以示
units.en: He then arranged the pitches in order to show
units.literal: He then arranged the pitches in order to show

units.zh: 涚。
units.en: Shu.
units.literal: Shu.

units.zh: 涚時七十餘，以為未始聞，而收未冠也。
units.en: Shu was then over seventy and thought he had never heard the like, while Shou had not yet come of age.
units.literal: Shu was then over seventy and thought he had never heard such things, while Shou had not yet come of age.

units.zh: 以兄假未仕，不肯舉進士。
units.en: Because his elder brother Jia had not yet entered office, he refused to sit for the jinshi examination.
units.literal: Because his elder brother Jia had not yet taken office, he refused to sit for the jinshi examination.

units.zh: 既假褫褐，乃入京師。
units.en: Once Jia had laid aside his commoner's robe, he entered the capital.
units.literal: Once Jia had removed his commoner's robe, he then entered the capital.

units.zh: 明年，擢進士，杜悰表署淮南推官。
units.en: The next year he passed the jinshi examination, and Du Cong recommended him as Huainan investigating officer.
units.literal: The next year he was selected as jinshi, and Du Cong recommended him for appointment as Huainan investigating officer.

units.zh: 悰領度支，又節度劍南東西川，輒隨府三遷。
units.en: Cong headed the revenue bureau and also governed the eastern and western Jiannan circuits; Shou followed his staff and was promoted three times.
units.literal: Cong headed the revenue bureau and also served as military governor of the eastern and western circuits of Jiannan; Shou followed his staff and was promoted three times.

units.zh: 宰相馬植表為渭南尉、集賢校理，議補監察御史。
units.en: Chief Minister Ma Zhi recommended him as magistrate of Weinan and collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and proposed him for investigating censor.
units.literal: Chief Minister Ma Zhi recommended him as magistrate of Weinan and collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and proposed him to fill a post as investigating censor.

units.zh: 收又以假方外遷，誼不可先，固辭。
units.en: Shou also said that with Jia being transferred outside the capital, propriety forbade his going first, and he firmly declined.
units.literal: Shou also said that because Jia was being transferred outside the capital, propriety did not allow him to go first, and firmly declined.

units.zh: 植嗟美為止。
units.en: Zhi sighed in admiration and dropped the matter.
units.literal: Zhi sighed in admiration and let the matter drop.

units.zh: 復為悰節度府判官。
units.en: He again served as judge on Cong's military governorship staff.
units.literal: He again served as judge in Cong's military governorship staff.

units.zh: 蜀有可縣，直巂州西南，地寬平，多水泉，可灌粳稻。
units.en: In Shu there was Keyi County, directly southwest of Xizhou; the land was broad and level, with many springs suitable for irrigating glutinous rice.
units.literal: In Shu there was Keyi County, due southwest of Xizhou; the land was broad and level, with many springs, and could irrigate glutinous rice.

units.zh: 或謂悰計興屯田，省轉饋以飽邊士，悰將從之，收曰：「田可致，兵不可得。
units.en: Someone urged Cong to open military colonies to cut transport costs and feed the border troops; Cong was about to agree when Shou said, "Fields can be created, but troops cannot be had.
units.literal: Someone urged Cong to plan opening military colonies to save transport costs and fill the border troops; Cong was about to follow this, but Shou said: "Fields can be brought into being, but troops cannot be obtained.

units.zh: 且地當蠻沖，本非中國。
units.en: Besides, the land lies on the barbarian frontier and was never truly Chinese territory.
units.literal: Moreover, the land lies on the barbarian frontier and was never part of the central domains.

units.zh: 今輟西南屯士往耕，則姚、巂兵少，賊得乘間。
units.en: If we now divert southwestern garrison troops to farming, Yao and Xi will be understrength and bandits can seize their chance.
units.literal: If we now divert southwestern garrison troops to farming, the armies of Yao and Xi will be few and bandits can seize the opportunity.

units.zh: 若調兵捍賊，則民疲士怨。
units.en: If troops are mobilized to fight bandits, the people will be worn out and the soldiers resentful.
units.literal: If troops are mobilized to repel bandits, the people will be exhausted and the soldiers resentful.

units.zh: 假令大穰，蠻得長驅，是資賊糧，豈國計耶？」
units.en: Even with a great harvest, barbarians could drive deep inland—this would supply the enemy with grain; how could that serve the state's interest?"
units.literal: Even if there were a great harvest, the barbarians could drive deep—this would supply the enemy with grain; how could it be national policy?"

units.zh: 乃止。
units.en: Cong then dropped the plan.
units.literal: Cong then stopped.

units.zh: 始，周墀罷宰相，節度東川，表其弟嚴掌書記。
units.en: Earlier, when Zhou Chi left the chief ministership to govern Dongchuan, he recommended his younger brother Yan as recorder.
units.literal: Earlier, when Zhou Chi was dismissed as chief minister and became military governor of Dongchuan, he recommended his younger brother Yan as recorder.

units.zh: 俄而墀卒，悰辟為觀察使判官，兄弟並在幕府。
units.en: Soon Chi died; Cong took Yan on as judge under the surveillance commissioner, and the brothers served together on the same staff.
units.literal: Soon Chi died; Cong recruited Yan as judge under the surveillance commissioner, and the brothers were both in the same staff.

units.zh: 未幾，假自浙西判官擢監察御史，而收亦自西川遷，兄弟同臺，世榮其友。
units.en: Before long Jia was promoted from Zhexi judge to investigating censor, and Shou also returned from Xichuan; the brothers served on the censorate together, and contemporaries honored their bond.
units.literal: Before long Jia was promoted from judge in Zhexi to investigating censor, and Shou also transferred from Xichuan; the brothers served on the censorate together, and the age honored their friendship.

units.zh: 以詳禮學改太常博士，而嚴亦自揚州召為監察禦使。
units.en: For his mastery of ritual studies he was made Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, while Yan was also recalled from Yangzhou as investigating censor.
units.literal: For his mastery of ritual studies he was made Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, while Yan was also summoned from Yangzhou as investigating censor.

units.zh: 收因建言：「漢制，總群官而聽曰省，分務而專治曰寺。
units.en: Shou then proposed: "Under Han institutions, offices that oversee all officials and hear cases are called sheng; those that divide duties for specialized administration are called si.
units.literal: Shou thereupon submitted a proposal: "Under Han institutions, offices that oversee all officials and hear cases are called sheng; those that divide duties and administer specialized affairs are called si.

units.zh: 太常，分務專治者也，所以藏天子之旗常。
units.en: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices divides duties for specialized administration—it is where the Son of Heaven's banners and regalia are kept.
units.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices is one that divides duties for specialized administration—it is where the Son of Heaven's banners and regalia are stored.

units.zh: 今旗常因車飾隸太仆，非是。」
units.en: Now banners and regalia follow carriage fittings under the Court of the Imperial Stud, which is wrong."
units.literal: Now banners and regalia follow carriage fittings under the Court of the Imperial Stud—this is not correct."

units.zh: 未及行，以母喪免。
units.en: Before this could be enacted, he left office to mourn his mother.
units.literal: Before this could be carried out, he was dismissed on account of his mother's mourning.

units.zh: 服除，從淮南崔鉉府為支使。
units.en: When mourning ended, he joined Cui Xian's Huainan staff as administrative aide.
units.literal: When mourning ended, he joined Cui Xian's Huainan staff as administrative aide.

units.zh: 還，拜侍御史。
units.en: On returning he was appointed attendant censor.
units.literal: On returning he was appointed attendant censor.

units.zh: 夏侯孜以宰相領度支，引判度支案。
units.en: Xiahou Zi, serving as chief minister, also headed the revenue bureau and brought Shou in to judge revenue cases.
units.literal: Xiahou Zi, as chief minister, also headed the revenue bureau and brought Shou in to judge revenue cases.

units.zh: 遷長安令。
units.en: He was transferred to magistrate of Chang'an.
units.literal: He was transferred to magistrate of Chang'an.

units.zh: 懿宗時，擢累中書舍人、翰林學士承旨，以中書侍郎同中書門下平章事。
units.en: Under Emperor Yizong he rose in succession to Secretariat Drafter, Chief Academician of the Hanlin Academy, and Grand Councillor as Vice Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: During the Yizong era he was promoted in succession to Secretariat Drafter, Chief Academician of the Hanlin Academy, and Grand Councillor as Vice Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 始，南蠻自大中以來，火邕州，掠交趾，調華人往屯，涉氛瘴死者十七，戰無功，蠻勢益張。
units.en: Since the Dazhong era the southern barbarians had burned Yongzhou and raided Jiaozhi; Chinese settlers were sent to garrison the region, seven in ten dying in the miasma, campaigns achieving nothing while barbarian power grew ever stronger.
units.literal: Earlier, since the Dazhong era the southern barbarians had burned Yongzhou, raided Jiaozhi, and Chinese settlers were mobilized to garrison the region; seven-tenths died crossing miasma, campaigns achieved nothing, and barbarian power grew ever stronger.

units.zh: 收議豫章募士三萬，置鎮南軍以拒蠻。
units.en: Shou proposed recruiting thirty thousand men from Yuzhang and establishing the Army to Pacify the South to hold the barbarians at bay.
units.literal: Shou proposed recruiting thirty thousand men from Yuzhang, establishing the Army to Pacify the South to resist the barbarians.

units.zh: 悉教蹋張，戰必註滿，蠻不能支。
units.en: They were all taught foot-drawn crossbows and always shot at full draw in battle; the barbarians could not stand against them.
units.literal: They were all taught to draw the crossbow by treading, and in battle always shot with full draw; the barbarians could not withstand them.

units.zh: 又峙食泛舟餉南海。
units.en: He also stockpiled grain and shipped it by boat to supply the Southern Sea command.
units.literal: He also stockpiled grain and sent it by boat to supply the Southern Sea.

units.zh: 天子嘉其功，進尚書右仆射，封晉陽縣男。
units.en: The emperor praised his achievement, promoted him to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and enfeoffed him as Baron of Jinyang.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven praised his achievement, advanced him to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and enfeoffed him as Baron of Jinyang County.

units.zh: 既益貴，稍自盛滿，為誇侈，門吏童客倚為奸。
units.en: As he grew still more eminent, he gradually became self-important, indulged in display, and his gate clerks and household boys relied on him to commit abuses.
units.literal: Once he grew still more eminent, he gradually became self-important, indulged in display, and his gate clerks and household boys relied on him to commit wrongdoing.

units.zh: 中尉楊玄價得君，而收與之厚，收之相，玄價實左右之；
units.en: Commandant Yang Xuanjia had won the emperor's favor, and Shou was close to him; when Shou became chief minister, Xuanjia in fact guided him from behind;
units.literal: The commandant Yang Xuanjia had won the ruler's favor, and Shou was close to him; when Shou became chief minister, Xuanjia in fact steered him from the side;

units.zh: 乃招四方賕餉數千諉收，不能從，玄價以負己，大恚，陰加毀短。
units.en: He then summoned bribes and gifts from all quarters by the thousands to denounce Shou, but Shou would not go along; Xuanjia took it as a personal slight and was furious, secretly slandering him.
units.literal: Then he summoned bribes and gifts from all quarters numbering in the thousands to denounce Shou, but Shou would not comply; Xuanjia took this as a personal slight and was greatly enraged, secretly adding slanders.

units.zh: 知政凡五年，罷為宣歙觀察使，不敢當兩使稟料，但受刺史俸，留公藏錢七百萬。
units.en: He governed for five years in all, was removed to surveillance commissioner of Xuanshe, refused the two commissioners' allowance and took only a prefect's salary, leaving seven million cash in the public treasury.
units.literal: He held power for five years in all, was dismissed to be surveillance commissioner of Xuanshe, dared not accept the two commissioners' allowance, took only the prefect's salary, and left seven million in the public treasury.

units.zh: 韋保衡又劾收前用嚴譔為江西節度使，受謝百萬，及它隱盜。
units.en: Wei Baoheng also impeached Shou for earlier appointing Yan Zan military governor of Jiangxi and accepting a million in bribes, along with other concealed thefts.
units.literal: Wei Baoheng also impeached Shou for earlier appointing Yan Zan as military governor of Jiangxi and accepting a bribe of a million, along with other concealed thefts.

units.zh: 明年，貶端州司馬。
units.en: The next year he was demoted to vice prefect of Duanzhou.
units.literal: The next year he was demoted to vice prefect of Duanzhou.

units.zh: 吏具大舟以須，收不從，曰：「方謫去，可乎？」
units.en: Clerks prepared a large boat for him; Shou refused and said, "I am only being banished—how is that acceptable?"
units.literal: The clerks prepared a large boat to await him; Shou would not use it and said: "I am just being banished—how can this be acceptable?"

units.zh: 以二小舸趨官。
units.en: He took two small boats and hurried to his post.
units.literal: He took two small boats and hurried to his post.

units.zh: 又明年，流州，俄詔內養追賜死。
units.en: The next year he was exiled to Zhou; soon an edict sent an inner-court eunuch to pursue him and order his death by poison.
units.literal: The next year he was exiled to Zhou; soon an edict sent an inner-court eunuch in pursuit and granted him death by poison.

units.zh: 收得詔，謝曰：「輔政無狀，固宜死。
units.en: Receiving the edict, Shou said, "As chief minister I was without merit and surely deserve death.
units.literal: Receiving the edict, Shou thanked and said: "As chief minister I was without merit and surely deserve death.

units.zh: 今獨一弟嚴以奉先人之祀，使者能假須臾使秉筆乎？」
units.en: Now only my younger brother Yan carries on sacrifice to our forebears—can the envoy grant me a moment to write?"
units.literal: Now I have only one younger brother, Yan, to carry on sacrifice to our forebears—can the envoy grant me a moment to take up the brush?"

units.zh: 使者從之。
units.en: The envoy agreed.
units.literal: The envoy agreed.

units.zh: 收自作書謝天子，丐弟嚴死，奉先臣後。
units.en: Shou himself wrote thanking the emperor, begging that his younger brother Yan be spared so that he could continue the ancestral sacrifices of their late father.
units.literal: Shou himself wrote a letter thanking the Son of Heaven, begging that his younger brother Yan die instead and continue the line of the former minister.

units.zh: 以書授使者，即仰鴆死。
units.en: He gave the letter to the envoy and at once drank poison and died.
units.literal: He handed the letter to the envoy and at once drank poison and died.

units.zh: 帝見書惻然，乃宥嚴，坐收流死者十一人。
units.en: The emperor, moved by the letter, pardoned Yan; eleven men were punished with exile on Shou's account.
units.literal: When the emperor saw the letter he was moved to pity and pardoned Yan; eleven persons were punished by exile on account of Shou.

units.zh: 後三年，詔追雪其辜，復官爵。
units.en: Three years later an edict posthumously cleared his guilt and restored his offices and titles.
units.literal: Three years later an edict posthumously cleared his guilt and restored his offices and titles.

units.zh: 子鉅、鏻。
units.en: His sons were Ju and Lin.
units.literal: His sons Ju and Lin.

units.zh: 鉅，乾寧初為翰林學士，從入洛，終散騎常侍。
units.en: Ju, at the start of Qianning, was a Hanlin academician, followed the court into Luoyang, and ended as Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary.
units.literal: Ju, at the beginning of the Qianning era, was a Hanlin academician, followed the court into Luoyang, and ended as Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary.

units.zh: 鏻至戶部尚書。
units.en: Lin rose to Minister of Revenue.
units.literal: Lin rose to Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 收兄發，字至之。
units.en: Shou's elder brother Fa, courtesy name Zhizhi.
units.literal: Shou's elder brother Fa, courtesy name Zhizhi.

units.zh: 登進士，又中拔萃，累官左司郎中。
units.en: He passed the jinshi examination and the special selection, rising to Left Department Director.
units.literal: He passed the jinshi examination, also passed the special selection, and rose through offices to Left Department Director.

units.zh: 宣宗追加順、憲二宗尊號，有司議改造廟主，署新謚，詔百官議。
units.en: When Emperor Xuanzong added posthumous honorific titles for Emperors Shun and Xian, the relevant offices debated remaking temple tablets and affixing new posthumous designations, and an edict ordered all officials to discuss it.
units.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong added posthumous honorific titles for Emperors Shun and Xian, the relevant offices debated remaking the temple tablets and affixing new posthumous designations, and an edict ordered all officials to discuss it.

units.zh: 發與都官郎中盧搏以為改作主，求古無文，執不可。
units.en: Fa, with Director of the Bureau of Review Lu Bo, held that remaking the main tablets had no ancient precedent and firmly opposed it.
units.literal: Fa, together with Director of the Bureau of Review Lu Bo, held that remaking the main tablets lacked any ancient precedent and firmly opposed it.

units.zh: 知禮者韙之。
units.en: Those versed in ritual approved.
units.literal: Those versed in ritual approved.

units.zh: 改太常少卿，為蘇州刺史，治以恭長慈幼為先。
units.en: He was made Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, then prefect of Suzhou, putting respect for elders and kindness to the young first in his governance.
units.literal: He was made Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, then prefect of Suzhou, governing with respect for elders and kindness to the young as his first principles.

units.zh: 徙福建觀察使，又以能政聞。
units.en: He was transferred to surveillance commissioner of Fujian and was again known for capable administration.
units.literal: He was transferred to surveillance commissioner of Fujian, and was again known for capable administration.

units.zh: 朝廷意有治劇才，拜嶺南節度使。
units.en: The court believed he had talent for governing difficult regions and made him military governor of Lingnan.
units.literal: The court believed he had talent for governing difficult regions and appointed him military governor of Lingnan.

units.zh: 承前寬弛，發操下剛嚴，軍遂怨，起為亂，囚傳舍，貶婺州刺史。
units.en: Following previous lenient rule, Fa enforced strict discipline; the army resented him, rebelled, imprisoned him at the relay station, and he was demoted to prefect of Wuzhou.
units.literal: Following the previous lenient rule, Fa enforced strict discipline on subordinates; the army therefore resented him, rose in revolt, imprisoned him at the relay station, and he was demoted to prefect of Wuzhou.

units.zh: 假，字仁之，仕終常州刺史。
units.en: Jia, courtesy name Renzhi, served to the end as prefect of Changzhou.
units.literal: Jia, courtesy name Renzhi, served to the end as prefect of Changzhou.

units.zh: 收與昆弟護喪葬偃師，會者千人。
units.en: Shou and his brothers escorted the coffin to burial at Yanshi, with a thousand in attendance.
units.literal: Shou and his brothers escorted the coffin for burial at Yanshi, and those who attended numbered a thousand.

units.zh: 嚴，字凜之，舉進士。
units.en: Yan, courtesy name Linzhi, passed the jinshi examination.
units.literal: Yan, courtesy name Linzhi, passed the jinshi examination.

units.zh: 時王起選士三十人，而楊知至、竇緘、源重、鄭樸及嚴五人皆世胄，起以聞，詔獨收嚴。
units.en: Wang Qi then selected thirty candidates; Yang Zhizhi, Dou Jian, Yuan Chong, Zheng Pu, and Yan—five men from eminent houses—were among them; Qi reported this, and an edict ordered Yan alone accepted.
units.literal: At the time Wang Qi selected thirty candidates, and Yang Zhizhi, Dou Jian, Yuan Chong, Zheng Pu, and Yan—five men—were all from eminent houses; Qi reported this, and an edict ordered that Yan alone be accepted.

units.zh: 累遷至工部侍郎、翰林學士。
units.en: He rose in succession to Vice Minister of Works and Hanlin academician.
units.literal: He was promoted in succession to Vice Minister of Works and Hanlin academician.

units.zh: 收知政，請補外，拜浙東觀察使。
units.en: When Shou held power he asked for an outside post and was made surveillance commissioner of Zhedong.
units.literal: When Shou held power he requested an outside post and was appointed surveillance commissioner of Zhedong.

units.zh: 收貶，嚴亦斥為邵州刺史，徙吉王傅。
units.en: When Shou was demoted, Yan was dismissed to prefect of Shaozhou and made tutor of the Prince of Ji.
units.literal: When Shou was demoted, Yan was also dismissed to prefect of Shaozhou and transferred to tutor of the Prince of Ji.

units.zh: 乾符中，以兵部侍郎判度支，卒。
units.en: In the Qianfu era he served as Vice Minister of War judging revenue cases, then died.
units.literal: In the Qianfu era he served as Vice Minister of War while judging revenue cases, then died.

units.zh: 子涉、註。
units.en: His sons were She and Zhu.
units.literal: His sons She and Zhu.

units.zh: 涉，昭宗時，仕至吏部侍郎。
units.en: She, under Emperor Zhaozong, rose to Vice Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: She, in the Zhaozong era, served to Vice Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 哀帝時，進同中書門下平章事。
units.en: Under Emperor Aidi he was advanced to Grand Councillor.
units.literal: In the Aidi era he was advanced to Grand Councillor.

units.zh: 為人端重有禮法。
units.en: He was dignified and observant of ritual propriety.
units.literal: As a man he was dignified and observant of ritual propriety.

units.zh: 方賊臣陵慢，王室殘蕩，賢人多罹患。
units.en: Rebel ministers were overbearing, the royal house battered, and worthy men mostly fell into trouble.
units.literal: Just then rebel ministers were overbearing, the royal house was battered, and worthy men mostly fell into trouble.

units.zh: 涉受命，與家人泣，語其子凝式曰：「世道方極，吾嬰網羅不能去，將重不幸，禍且累汝。」
units.en: On receiving appointment, She wept with his family and told his son Ningshi, "The age is at its extreme; I am caught in the net and cannot leave, and fresh misfortune awaits—disaster will reach even you."
units.literal: On receiving the appointment, She wept with his family and told his son Ningshi: "The age is at its extreme; I am caught in the net and cannot leave, and will meet fresh misfortune—disaster will reach even you."

units.zh: 然以謙靖，終免於禍。
units.en: Yet through modesty and restraint he ultimately escaped calamity.
units.literal: Yet through modesty and restraint he ultimately escaped calamity.

units.zh: 註為翰林學士。
units.en: Zhu was a Hanlin academician.
units.literal: Zhu was a Hanlin academician.

units.zh: 涉已相，辭內職，為戶部侍郎。
units.en: After She became chief minister he resigned his inner-court post and was made Vice Minister of Revenue.
units.literal: After She became chief minister he resigned his inner-court post and was made Vice Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 路巖，字魯瞻，魏州冠氏人。
units.en: Lu Yan, courtesy name Luzhan, was from Guanshi in Weizhou.
units.literal: Lu Yan, courtesy name Luzhan, was a man of Guanshi in Weizhou.

units.zh: 父群，字正夫，通經術，善屬文。
units.en: His father Qun, courtesy name Zhengfu, mastered the classics and was skilled at composition.
units.literal: His father Qun, courtesy name Zhengfu, mastered the classics and was skilled at composition.

units.zh: 性誌純潔，親歿，終身不肉食。
units.en: Pure and upright by nature, after his parents died he ate no meat for the rest of his life.
units.literal: His nature was pure and upright; after his parents died he ate no meat for the rest of his life.

units.zh: 累官中書舍人、翰林學士承旨，文宗優遇之。
units.en: He rose to Secretariat Drafter and Chief Hanlin Academician, and Emperor Wenzong treated him with special favor.
units.literal: He rose through offices to Secretariat Drafter and Chief Academician of the Hanlin Academy, and Emperor Wenzong treated him with special favor.

units.zh: 居循循謙飭，若不在勢位者。
units.en: In conduct he was steadily modest and restrained, as if he held no power.
units.literal: In conduct he was steadily modest and restrained, as if he did not hold power.

units.zh: 所與交，雖褐衣之賤，待以禮，始終一節。
units.en: Those he associated with, even men in coarse cloth of humble rank, he treated with courtesy from first to last without change.
units.literal: Those with whom he associated, even men in coarse cloth of humble rank, he treated with courtesy from beginning to end without change.

units.zh: 巖幼惠敏過人，及進士第，父時故人在方鎮者交辟之，久乃答。
units.en: Yan in youth was exceptionally clever; after passing jinshi, his father's old friends in regional commands all invited him, and only after long delay did he respond.
units.literal: Yan in youth was clever and keen beyond others; after passing the jinshi examination, his father's old friends in the regional commands all invited him in turn, and only after a long time did he respond.

units.zh: 懿宗咸通初，自屯田員外郎入翰林為學士，以兵部侍郎同中書門下平章事，年三十六。
units.en: At the start of Xiantong under Emperor Yizong he entered the Hanlin from outer-court member of the Ministry of Revenue, became academician, then Grand Councillor as Vice Minister of War at thirty-six.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xiantong under Emperor Yizong he entered the Hanlin from the post of outer-court member of the Ministry of Revenue and became academician, then Grand Councillor as Vice Minister of War at age thirty-six.

units.zh: 居位八歲，進至尚書左仆射。
units.en: He held office eight years and advanced to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: He held office eight years and advanced to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 於是王政秕僻，宰相得用事。
units.en: Royal government was corrupt and perverse, and chief ministers could wield power.
units.literal: At this time royal government was corrupt and perverse, and chief ministers could wield power.

units.zh: 巖顧天子荒暗，且以政委己，乃通賂遺，奢肆不法。
units.en: Seeing the emperor benighted and authority resting with himself, Yan trafficked in bribes and indulged in extravagance and lawlessness.
units.literal: Yan saw that the Son of Heaven was benighted and that administrative authority rested with himself, and therefore trafficked in bribes and gifts, indulging in extravagance and lawlessness.

units.zh: 俄與韋保衡同當國，二人勢動天下，時目其黨為「牛頭阿旁」，言如鬼陰惡可畏也。
units.en: Soon he shared power with Wei Baoheng; their influence shook the empire, and contemporaries called their faction "Ox-Head and A-Bang," like secret, fearsome demons.
units.literal: Soon he shared state power with Wei Baoheng; the two men's influence shook the empire, and the age called their faction "Ox-Head and A-Bang," saying they were like demons—secret, evil, and fearsome.

units.zh: 既權侔則爭，故與保衡還相惡。
units.en: Once their powers were equal they quarreled, and he and Baoheng came to hate each other.
units.literal: Once their powers were equal they quarreled, and therefore he and Baoheng came to hate each other in turn.

units.zh: 俄罷巖為劍南西川節度使，承蠻盜邊後，巖力拊循，置定邊軍於邛州，扼大度，治故關，取壇丁子弟教擊刺，使補屯籍，由是西山八國來朝。
units.en: Soon Yan was sent to govern Jiannan West; after barbarian raids he worked to pacify the border, established the Army to Secure the Border at Qiongzhou, blocked Dadu, restored old passes, trained Tanding youths in arms to fill garrison rolls, and the eight Western Hill kingdoms came to court.
units.literal: Soon Yan was dismissed to military governor of Jiannan West Circuit; following the barbarian raids on the border, Yan worked hard to comfort and pacify, established the Army to Secure the Border at Qiongzhou, blocked Dadu, restored old passes, took young men of the Tanding to teach thrusting and stabbing and fill garrison rolls, and thereby the eight kingdoms of the Western Hills came to court.

units.zh: 以勞遷兼中書令，封魏國公。
units.en: For his labors he was made concurrent Director of the Secretariat and enfeoffed Duke of Wei.
units.literal: For his labors he was transferred to concurrent Director of the Secretariat and enfeoffed as Duke of Wei.

units.zh: 始，為相時，委事親吏邊鹹。
units.en: Earlier, as chief minister, he entrusted affairs to his close clerk Bian Xian.
units.literal: Earlier, when he was chief minister, he entrusted affairs to his close clerk Bian Xian.

units.zh: 會至德令陳蟠叟奏書願請間言財利，帝召見，則曰：「臣願破邊鹹家，可佐軍興。」
units.en: Chen Pansou, magistrate of Zhide, asked a private audience on finances; summoned, he said, "I wish to break up Bian Xian's household to aid military expenditure."
units.literal: It happened that Chen Pansou, magistrate of Zhide, submitted a memorial asking for a private audience on financial matters; the emperor summoned him, and he said: "Your subject wishes to break up Bian Xian's household—this could aid military expenditure."

units.zh: 帝問：「鹹何人？」
units.en: The emperor asked, "Who is Xian?"
units.literal: The emperor asked: "Who is Xian?"

units.zh: 對曰：「宰相巖親吏也。」
units.en: He answered, "Chief Minister Yan's close clerk."
units.literal: He answered: "Chief Minister Yan's close clerk."

units.zh: 帝怒，斥蟠叟，自是人無敢言。
units.en: The emperor was angry and dismissed Pansou; thereafter no one dared speak.
units.literal: The emperor was angry and dismissed Pansou; from then on no one dared speak.

units.zh: 鹹乃與郭籌者相依倚為奸，巖不甚制，軍中惟邊將軍、郭司馬爾，妄給與以結士心。
units.en: Xian then relied on Guo Chou for wrongdoing; Yan scarcely restrained them, and in the army only General Bian and Marshal Guo gave rewards at will to win soldiers' hearts.
units.literal: Xian then relied on Guo Chou to do wrong together; Yan did not much restrain them, and in the army there were only General Bian and Marshal Guo, who gave out rewards at will to win soldiers' hearts.

units.zh: 嘗閱武都場，鹹、籌蒞之，其議事以書相示則焚之，軍中驚，以有異圖，恟恟，遂聞京師。
units.en: Reviewing troops at Wudu field, Xian and Chou attended; when they showed written plans they burned them; the army was alarmed at secret designs, and uproar reached the capital.
units.literal: Once when reviewing troops at Wudu field, Xian and Chou attended; when they showed each other written plans they burned them; the army was alarmed, thinking they had secret designs, and uproar reached the capital.

units.zh: 巖坐是徙荊南節度使，道貶新州刺史，至江陵，免官，流儋州，籍入其家。
units.en: Yan was transferred to Jingnan; on the road demoted to prefect of Xinzhou; at Jiangling stripped of office, exiled to Danzhou, household confiscated.
units.literal: Yan on this account was transferred to military governor of Jingnan; on the road he was demoted to prefect of Xinzhou; reaching Jiangling he was stripped of office, exiled to Danzhou, and his household was registered and confiscated.

units.zh: 巖體貌偉麗，美須髯，至江陵兩昔皆白。
units.en: Yan was tall and handsome with a fine beard; by Jiangling both temples had turned white.
units.literal: Yan was tall and handsome with a fine beard; by the time he reached Jiangling both temples were white.

units.zh: 捕誅鹹、籌等。
units.en: Xian, Chou, and the rest were captured and executed.
units.literal: Xian, Chou, and the rest were captured and executed.

units.zh: 巖至新州，詔賜死，剔取喉，上有司。
units.en: At Xinzhou an edict granted death by poison; his throat was cut out and sent to the relevant office.
units.literal: When Yan reached Xinzhou an edict granted death by poison; his throat was cut out and sent up to the relevant office.

units.zh: 或言巖嘗密請「三品以上得罪誅殛，剔取喉驗其已死」。
units.en: Some said Yan had once secretly requested that "for third-rank offenders and above who were executed, the throat be cut out to verify death."
units.literal: Some said Yan had once secretly requested that "for offenders of the third rank and above who were executed, the throat be cut out to verify death."

units.zh: 俄而自及。
units.en: Soon it fell on him.
units.literal: Soon the rule fell on him.

units.zh: 保衡者，京兆人，字蘊用。
units.en: Baoheng was from Jingzhao, courtesy name Yunyong.
units.literal: As for Baoheng, he was a man of Jingzhao, courtesy name Yunyong.

units.zh: 父愨，宣宗時，終武昌軍節度使。
units.en: His father Que, under Emperor Xuanzong, ended as military governor of Wuchang.
units.literal: His father Que, in the Xuanzong era, ended as military governor of the Wuchang army.

units.zh: 保衡，咸通中，以右拾遺尚同昌公主，遷起居郎、駙馬都尉。
units.en: In Xiantong, as Right Reminder he married Princess Tongchang and became Attendant of the Bedchamber and Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-law.
units.literal: Baoheng, in the Xiantong era, as Right Reminder married Princess Tongchang and was transferred to Attendant of the Bedchamber and Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-law.

units.zh: 主，郭淑妃所生，懿宗所愛，而妃有寵，故恩禮最異，悉宮中珍玩資予之。
units.en: The princess was Consort Guo Shufei's daughter, whom Yizong loved; the consort was favored, so honors were exceptional and all palace treasures were lavished on her.
units.literal: The princess was born to Consort Guo Shufei, whom Emperor Yizong loved; because the consort was favored, the honors were most exceptional, and all the palace treasures and curios were given to her.

units.zh: 俄歷翰林學士承旨，以兵部侍郎同中書門下平章事，自尚主至是裁再期。
units.en: Soon he was Chief Hanlin Academician and Grand Councillor as Vice Minister of War—from marrying the princess barely two years had passed.
units.literal: Soon he served in succession as Chief Hanlin Academician and Grand Councillor as Vice Minister of War—from marrying the princess to this point barely two years had passed.

units.zh: 又進門下侍郎、尚書右仆射。
units.en: He was further advanced to Vice Director of the Chancery and Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: He was further advanced to Vice Director of the Chancery and Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 性浮淺，既恃恩據權，以嫌愛自肆，所悅即擢，不悅擠之。
units.en: Shallow by nature, once he relied on favor and power he indulged likes and dislikes—promoting favorites and squeezing out others.
units.literal: Shallow by nature, once he relied on favor and grasped power he indulged likes and dislikes at will—those he favored were promoted, those he disliked were squeezed out.

units.zh: 保衡舉進士王鐸第，於籍、蕭遘與同升，以嘗薄於己，皆見斥。
units.en: Baoheng had ranked Wang Duo in jinshi; Yu Ji and Xiao Gun rose with him, but because they had slighted him, all were dismissed.
units.literal: Baoheng had ranked Wang Duo in the jinshi list; Yu Ji and Xiao Gun had risen with him, but because they had once slighted him, all were dismissed.

units.zh: 逐楊收，傾路巖，人益畏之。
units.en: He drove out Yang Shou and overthrew Lu Yan, and people feared him all the more.
units.literal: He drove out Yang Shou and overthrew Lu Yan, and people feared him all the more.

units.zh: 主薨，而寵遇不衰。
units.en: The princess died, yet favor did not decline.
units.literal: The princess died, yet favor did not decline.

units.zh: 僖宗立，進司徒。
units.en: When Emperor Xizong took the throne, he was advanced to Minister of Works.
units.literal: When Emperor Xizong took the throne, he was advanced to Minister of Works.

units.zh: 俄為怨家白髮陰罪，貶賀州刺史，再貶澄邁令，遂賜死。
units.en: Soon enemies exposed his hidden crimes; he was demoted to prefect of Hezhou, again to magistrate of Chengmai, and finally granted death by poison.
units.literal: Soon enemies exposed his hidden crimes, and he was demoted to prefect of Hezhou, demoted again to magistrate of Chengmai, and finally granted death by poison.

units.zh: 弟保乂，自兵部侍郎貶賓州司戶參軍。
units.en: His younger brother Baoyi was demoted from Vice Minister of War to registrar of Binzhou.
units.literal: His younger brother Baoyi was demoted from Vice Minister of War to registrar of Binzhou.

units.zh: 而劉瞻等坐主薨見貶者，偕復起。
units.en: Liu Zhan and others demoted on account of the princess's death were all restored together.
units.literal: Liu Zhan and others who had been demoted on account of the princess's death were all restored together.

units.zh: 盧攜，字子升，其先本范陽，世居鄭。
units.en: Lu Xie, courtesy name Zisheng—his ancestors were originally from Fanyang and for generations lived in Zheng.
units.literal: Lu Xie, courtesy name Zisheng—his ancestors were originally from Fanyang and for generations lived in Zheng.

units.zh: 擢進士第，被辟浙東府。
units.en: He passed jinshi and was recruited into the Zhedong staff.
units.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and was recruited into the Zhedong staff.

units.zh: 入朝為右拾遺，歷臺省，累進戶部侍郎、翰林學士承旨。
units.en: Entering court as Right Reminder, he passed through the censorate and secretariat, rising to Vice Minister of Revenue and Chief Hanlin Academician.
units.literal: Entering court as Right Reminder, he passed through the censorate and secretariat, and was promoted in succession to Vice Minister of Revenue and Chief Hanlin Academician.

units.zh: 乾符五年，進同中書門下平章事。
units.en: In the fifth year of Qianfu he was advanced to Grand Councillor.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Qianfu he was advanced to Grand Councillor.

units.zh: 俄拜中書侍郎、刑部尚書、弘文館大學士。
units.en: Soon he was Vice Director of the Secretariat, Minister of Justice, and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, Minister of Justice, and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall.

units.zh: 攜姿陋而語不正，與鄭畋俱李翺甥，同位宰相，然所處議多駁。
units.en: Xie was ugly and did not speak properly; he and Zheng Tian were both Li Ao's nephews and served together as chief ministers, yet their policy views often clashed.
units.literal: Xie was ugly in appearance and did not speak properly; he and Zheng Tian were both nephews of Li Ao and served together as chief ministers, yet their positions on policy were often at odds.

units.zh: 初，王仙芝起河南，攜表宋威、齊克讓、曾袞皆善將，為招討使。
units.en: When Wang Xianzhi rose in Henan, Xie memorialized that Song Wei, Qi Kerang, and Zeng Gun were skilled generals and should be suppression commissioners.
units.literal: Earlier, when Wang Xianzhi rose in Henan, Xie memorialized that Song Wei, Qi Kerang, and Zeng Gun were all skilled generals and should be made suppression commissioners.

units.zh: 及威殺尚君長，賊熾結，益不制，乃以王鐸鎮荊南，為諸道都統。
units.en: When Wei killed Shang Junzhang the rebels grew fiercer and less controllable; Wang Duo was stationed at Jingnan as overall commander of all circuits.
units.literal: When Wei killed Shang Junzhang the rebels grew fierce and were less controllable; Wang Duo was therefore stationed at Jingnan as overall commander of all circuits.

units.zh: 攜不悅。
units.en: Xie was displeased.
units.literal: Xie was displeased.

units.zh: 是時，黃巢已破廣州，勢張甚，表求天平節度使，詔宰相百官議。
units.en: Huang Chao had already taken Guangzhou and his power was vast; he requested military governor of Pingyi, and an edict ordered chief ministers and officials to discuss it.
units.literal: At this time Huang Chao had already taken Guangzhou and his power was greatly extended; he memorialized requesting the post of military governor of Pingyi, and an edict ordered chief ministers and all officials to discuss it.

units.zh: 攜素厚高駢，屬令立功，乃固不可巢請，又欲激巢使戰而敗鐸，因授率府率。
units.en: Xie was close to Gao Pian and wished him merit; he firmly opposed Chao's request, also hoping to provoke Chao to fight and defeat Duo, and appointed him Rate-Setting Colonel.
units.literal: Xie had long been close to Gao Pian and wished him to win merit; he therefore firmly opposed Chao's request, also wishing to provoke Chao to fight and defeat Duo, and so appointed him Rate-Setting Colonel.

units.zh: 又徇駢與南詔和親，與畋爭，相恨詈，繇是罷為太子賓客，分司東都。
units.en: He also indulged Pian in peace with Nanzhao; he quarreled with Tian in mutual hatred, and was dismissed to Palace Companion at the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: He also indulged Pian in making peace with Nanzhao; he quarreled with Tian, cursing each other in hatred, and on this account was dismissed to Palace Companion with duties at the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 俄為兵部尚書。
units.en: Soon he was made Minister of War.
units.literal: Soon he was made Minister of War.

units.zh: 會駢將張璘破賊，帝復召攜以門下侍郎同平章事。
units.en: When Pian's general Zhang Lin defeated the rebels, the emperor again summoned Xie as Vice Director of the Chancery and Grand Councillor.
units.literal: When Pian's general Zhang Lin defeated the rebels, the emperor again summoned Xie as Vice Director of the Chancery and Grand Councillor.

units.zh: 及鐸失守，以駢代之，即按關東諸將為鐸、畋所任者，悉易置。
units.en: When Duo lost his post, Pian replaced him; he then reviewed eastern-pass generals appointed by Duo and Tian and replaced them all.
units.literal: When Duo lost his defense, Pian replaced him; he then reviewed the generals of the eastern passes appointed by Duo and Tian and replaced them all.

units.zh: 內倚田令孜，而外寄戎政於駢，與奪惟所愛惡。
units.en: Within he relied on Tian Lingzi, while outwardly he entrusted military affairs to Pian, appointing and dismissing as he pleased.
units.literal: Within he relied on Tian Lingzi, while outwardly he entrusted military affairs to Pian, giving and taking posts according to likes and dislikes.

units.zh: 後病風足蹇，神智瞑塞，事多決於親吏楊溫、李脩，賄賂顯行。
units.en: Later he fell ill with wind paralysis and lame feet, his mind dim; most affairs were decided by close clerks Yang Wen and Li Xiu, and bribery flourished openly.
units.literal: Later he fell ill with wind affliction and lame feet, his mind dim and blocked; most affairs were decided by his close clerks Yang Wen and Li Xiu, and bribery was openly practiced.

units.zh: 及巢破淮南，璘戰死，忠武兵亂，天下危懼，人皆咎攜，始下詔以巢為天平節度使。
units.en: When Chao broke Huainan, Lin died in battle, and the Zhongwu army mutinied; the empire was terrified and all blamed Xie; only then was an edict issued making Chao military governor of Pingyi.
units.literal: When Chao broke Huainan, Lin died in battle, and the Zhongwu army mutinied; the empire was terrified and all blamed Xie; only then was an edict issued making Chao military governor of Pingyi.

units.zh: 詔下，賊已破潼關。
units.en: When the edict was issued, the rebels had already broken Tong Pass.
units.literal: When the edict was issued, the rebels had already broken Tong Pass.

units.zh: 明日，以太子賓客罷，分司東都，是夜仰藥死。
units.en: The next day he was dismissed as Palace Companion at the Eastern Capital; that night he took poison and died.
units.literal: The next day he was dismissed as Palace Companion with duties at the Eastern Capital; that night he took poison and died.

units.zh: 巢入京師，斫棺磔屍於長安市。
units.en: When Chao entered the capital he hacked open the coffin and exposed the corpse in Chang'an marketplace.
units.literal: When Chao entered the capital he hacked open the coffin and exposed the corpse in the marketplace of Chang'an.

units.zh: 子晏，天祐初為河南尉，柳璨殺之。
units.en: His son Yan, at the start of Tianyou served as magistrate of Henan; Liu Can killed him.
units.literal: His son Yan, at the beginning of Tianyou served as magistrate of Henan; Liu Can killed him.

units.zh: 贊曰：盧攜之敗王鐸，私高駢，賊遂卷鹹、鎬而西，易若舉毛，可謂朝無人焉。
units.en: The appraisal says: Lu Xie's undoing of Wang Duo and private favoring of Gao Pian let the rebels sweep through Xian and Hao westward as easily as lifting a hair—the court had no one fit for the task.
units.literal: The appraisal says: Lu Xie's defeat of Wang Duo and private favoring of Gao Pian caused the rebels to roll through Xian and Hao westward as easily as lifting a hair—one may say the court had no men.

units.zh: 唐將亡，攜為之鴟梟，宜天之假手於賊而磔其枯胔也。
units.en: As Tang was about to perish, Xie was its owl and kite; Heaven rightly used the rebels to hack apart his dried corpse.
units.literal: When Tang was about to perish, Xie was its owl and kite; it was fitting that Heaven used the rebels to expose his dried carcass.
